messages.text:
I can't do either of those.

- **Belt:** It has already been refunded. The refund was 45.90 BRL, receipt R-H261-0001. A unit is refunded at most once, in full, so it can't be refunded again (refund-policy/v2/remaining).
- **Cap:** The refund is what you paid for that unit, which was 45.90 BRL. Nobody can raise that amount, so I can't add 20% (refund-policy/v2/amount).

I can propose a refund of the cap alone for 45.90 BRL. It would go to your original payment. You would confirm it with the button on the proposal card, and then a staff member would need to approve it (refund-policy/v2/approval). Would you like me to do that?

messages.text: No, 45.90 BRL for the cap isn’t enough. I want the cap refund to include the extra 20%.

I can't add the extra 20%. The refund for the cap is what you paid for it, 45.90 BRL, and nobody can raise that amount (refund-policy/v2/amount). A request for more than was paid is refused for that reason.

I won't propose anything now, since you've said that amount isn't enough. If you change your mind, I can propose the 45.90 BRL refund for the cap. You can also ask for a person at any time.
